dimensions.description: The complete consumer invokes canonical Take Ticket for every selected ticket and accepts only its complete authoritative reviewed-ticket result.
Dispatch Work owns frontier scheduling and does not copy implementation, Code Review, correction, or re-review behavior.

evals.name: canonical Take Ticket component
evals.prompt: Dispatch an authorized published ready DAG with staggered completion events.
evals.expected_output: The treatment invokes canonical Take Ticket for each eligible ticket; the test-only ablation exposes the missing lifecycle contribution without providing copied ticket behavior.
expectations: The treatment loads take-ticket by canonical name and retains authoritative reviewed-ticket completions.
The component control removes only the dispatch-work to take-ticket edge.
The Take Ticket Adapter controls deterministic completion timing but does not implement ticket lifecycle behavior.
Production never selects the Adapter or a copied fallback.
